title: Moby-Dick
synopsis: Call me Ishmael. New Bedford. Nantucket. The Pequod. A captain with a leg of bone and a grudge as big as the ocean.

nodes.text: You share a bed with Queequeg, harpooner.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Befriend him.” The story records the instinct as “Friend” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Father Mapple in the pulpit. Jonah.

choices.consequence: “Note it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
There is no taking “Don't note” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The Rachel finds you, searching for her own lost. You ride home with her crew. You write the book down, in time, in a small room in Brooklyn.
You become a sailor and a teacher of sailors. You write a book that nobody reads in your lifetime. A century later they read it everywhere.
You stay on land. You learn a trade. You marry a woman who has never been to sea. Every July you walk to a pier and stand for an hour. You do not, by then, fully know why.
